name: @even/fact-check
description: Conversation fact-checker: long-press to check claims against your private context.

scripts.qr: evenhub qr --ip "$(ipconfig getifaddr "$(route -n get default | awk '/interface:/{print $2}')")" --port 5176 --http
scripts.pack: npm run build && evenhub pack app.json ./dist --output ../../fact-check.ehpk
